entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: The white-aligned court of the Realm on Eldraine, exemplifying Loyalty, home to the Circle of Loyalty; it fell in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane on which Ardenvale lies.

entities.name: Vantress
entities.description: The court bordering Ardenvale, to which Will Kenrith moved the realm's rule.

entities.name: Circle of Loyalty
entities.description: A magical ring of eternally burning silver fire in which aspirant knights prove their loyalty.

entities.name: Algenus Kenrith
entities.description: The humble man chosen by the Questing Beast who became High King, was turned into a stag by Oko, and was killed defending the castle.

entities.name: Linden Kenrith
entities.description: Queen of the realm who took Rowan and Will as her children and was killed defending Ardenvale.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A Kenrith twin who ignited a shared spark with Will.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A Kenrith twin and acting king who moved rule to Castle Vantress and captured Eriette.

entities.name: Questing Beast
entities.description: A beast that chose Algenus and Linden to quest for the high rulership.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A malevolent planeswalker who abducted the High King and turned him into a stag.

entities.name: Queen Ayara
entities.description: A queen who sent an envoy to negotiate with the Council of Druids.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch who claimed Castle Ardenvale after its fall and was later deposed and captured by Will.

entities.name: Elven Lords
entities.description: Lords who enslaved mankind before being overthrown.

entities.name: The Wilds
entities.description: The wild regions of Eldraine from which non-human threats arise.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Ardenvale and the other courts fell.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space across which the twins' spark sent them to a new plane.

events.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords from the mesa that would become Castle Ardenvale and founds five knightly courts around the Circle of Loyalty.
events.quote: mankind took a stand on the mesa that would become Castle Ardenvale and overthrew the Elven Lords that had enslaved them.

events.summary: The Questing Beast chooses Algenus Kenrith and Linden to quest; Algenus becomes High King.
events.quote: the Questing Beast chose the humble Algenus Kenrith and Linden to quest for the high rulership

events.summary: Oko abducts the High King and turns him into a stag, and the courts struggle to coordinate against the Wilds.
events.quote: After the High King was abducted by Oko , the fey, around 4561 AR and turned into a stag

events.summary: The royal twins find their father but their shared planeswalker spark ignites and sends them across the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: the Kenrith twins' shared Planeswalker's spark ignited, sending them across the Blind Eternities to a new plane.

events.summary: Ardenvale falls to the Phyrexian invaders; Algenus and Linden are killed in its defense.
events.quote: High King Algenus and Queen Linden Kenrith were killed in the castle's defense

events.summary: Will moves rule to Castle Vantress, Eriette claims Ardenvale, and she is eventually deposed and captured by Will.
events.quote: She was eventually deposed and captured by Will.

relations.note: Married him and took his children as her own.
relations.quote: After she married Algenus, she took them in as her children.

relations.note: Abducted him and turned him into a stag.
relations.quote: After the High King was abducted by Oko
She was eventually deposed and captured by Will.

relations.note: Chose him to quest for high rulership and gave him a sword.
relations.quote: gave each a sword as the mark of its favor

relations.note: The two courts border each other.
